9つのBlenderシーン、画像・Balanced動画・BOM・配置。: Nine Blender scenes, images, Balanced videos, BOMs and placements.
Monaのひげ先端7部品は先に置いた仮支持台へ上から載せ、後から上側の部品を取り: Place Mona's seven whisker-tip parts down onto pre-positioned temporary cradles, then attach the upper parts. Do not remove the cradles until physical retention is verified.
ひげは原型位置を保持して格子幅に増厚。選択後に細径のキー付き別体パーツを検討しま: Whiskers retain their original positions but are thickened to the voxel grid. Separate thin keyed parts were a possible later study, not an approved redesign.
原型はヘルメット状の頭部と側面突起です。原型にない胴体・四肢は追加していません。: The source is a helmet-like head with side projections. No body or limbs absent from the source were added.
名目挿入経路は占有セルと鉛直方向で検査。手・工具・変形・印刷誤差を含む組立保証で: Nominal insertion checks use occupied cells and vertical movement. They do not guarantee assembly with real hands, tools, deformation or print tolerances.
塗色は元3MF由来の近似です。格子未満の特徴は太くなり、曲面には段差が残ります。: Colors approximate the original 3MF. Sub-grid features become thicker and curved surfaces remain stepped.
外観基準のみ選択済み。接合部・組立は試作であり、実機嵌合・保持力・製造リリースは: Only the visual baselines are selected. Joints and assembly are prototypes; physical fit, retention and production release are unapproved.
外観比較用。実機嵌合・荷重・差込経路は未検証で、量産用キットではありません。: For visual comparison. Physical fit, loads and insertion paths are unvalidated. This is not a production-ready kit.
最初は選択ピッチの小型試験セットのみ。全体の部品を印刷しないでください。印刷時間: The recorded plan starts with small trials for the chosen pitch only. Do not print all figure parts. Print time, mass and slicing results are unvalidated.
細密案のソケット最小壁は公称 0.88 mm。部品増は嵌合精度を保証せず、小パー: Historical Fine sockets have a nominal minimum wall of 0.88 mm. More parts do not guarantee fit accuracy. The earlier assumptions considered a 0.2 mm nozzle for small details and 0.4 mm for main parts; details required redesign. These are not validated print settings.
色別の単色パーツをプレート単位で印刷する想定です。AMSは不要、配置と支持材は未: The concept assumes separate single-color parts printed by plate. AMS is not required; plate layouts and supports have not been designed for the full figures.
選定3種のBlender、実画像・動画、個別/集計BOM、配置・組立候補。: Blender scenes, actual images/videos, individual and summary BOMs, placements and proposed sequences for the three selected candidates.
